name: comp-134
title: Colored Checkbox
blurb: Checkbox styled with a custom indigo color theme.
description: Pre-checked checkbox with custom color via CSS custom properties (indigo). Demonstrates theming by overriding --primary and --ring variables.
avoid_when: Always use theme tokens—hardcoded colors will break in dark mode.
a11y: Checkbox and label properly associated. Keyboard support. Color alone doesn't convey state.
